name: Empty Cleansing Bowl
summary: In Auberdine, the Empty Cleansing Bowl carries moonwell water against the Blackwood corruption. Mixed with food samples, the water makes a meal that briefly breaks the satyrs’ demonic hold over the furbolgs.

sections.title: A Vessel of Purification
sections.body: In Auberdine, Thundris Windweaver gives adventurers the Empty Cleansing Bowl to carry sacred water from the local moonwell. The night elves have learned that satyrs use enchanted talismans to drive the northern Blackwood furbolgs into demonic madness. Dip the bowl in the moonwell, then mix its water with nuts, grains, and fruits gathered from the furbolgs. The blessed meal briefly restores the afflicted creatures’ sanity and reveals the satyr overseer behind their madness.

faq.q: What do I do with the Empty Cleansing Bowl?
aliases: how to use empty cleansing bowl
faq.answer: Take the bowl to the Auberdine moonwell and dip it in the blessed waters to make a Filled Cleansing Bowl. Then gather grain, nut, and fruit samples from the northern Blackwood furbolg camp to mix with the water.

faq.q: Why do the night elves need this bowl to fight the furbolg corruption?
faq.answer: Satyr talismans bind the Blackwood furbolgs with dark magic. Thundris Windweaver uses the bowl to hold a sanctified mixture that briefly breaks their frenzy and draws out their hidden controller, Xabraxxis.

faq.q: Who provides the Empty Cleansing Bowl?
faq.answer: Thundris Windweaver, a night elf scholar in Auberdine, gives you the bowl when he asks you to uncover the source of the Blackwood corruption along the Cliffspring River.

faq.q: What happens once the mixture is prepared?
faq.answer: Set the prepared mixture near the northern camp’s bonfire. It cleanses nearby furbolgs long enough to draw Xabraxxis’s fury, letting you slay the satyr and claim his Talisman of Corruption.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see how Elune’s moonwells can undo demonic taint. The cleansing offers hope that your old furbolg allies may be saved.
As a druid, you use moonwell waters to break unnatural afflictions. It reflects your calling to mend nature’s wounded balance across Darkshore.
